C0211.title: Guangzhou Cross-Border E-Commerce Bonded Warehouse Click-Farm Tax Fraud Verdict Announced
C0211.summary: In April 2018, the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court delivered a verdict in a cross-border bonded warehouse click-farming smuggling case. A Guangzhou-based supply chain company used fabricated transactions to falsely declare trade and import goods, evading about 2.07 million yuan in taxes. Some of those involved were placed under criminal detention in December 2015, while others were arrested or released on bail in January 2016. The case stands as a landmark precedent for click-farming-based tax fraud in the cross-border e-commerce sector.
